title: rlds-paired: Paired Dark-Sector Signature SDK
description: Reference implementation for the paired growth-suppression signature of the Regime-Limited Dynamical Systems (RLDS) interacting dark-sector model, accompanying RLDS Papers III-V. The package recomputes the headline results (paired coefficient c, spectral gap delta_max, attractor R*, present-day matter fraction) directly from the model code rather than storing literals, and exposes a CLI (verify, scan, spectral, fsigma8).
